features: 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging compatible with iPhone and Android — 25W Wireless Charging (Qi2.2) is supported for the iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Plus, iPhone 16 Pro, iPhone 16 Pro Max, iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone 17 Pro Max - Qi 2.2 certified with up to 25W wireless output, delivering fast and efficient charging for all Qi-compatible devices. Magnetic alignment ensures effortless snap-on placement with no guesswork — just attach and power up.

Segment-Leading 45W Wired Fast Charging — Charge your smartphone, table at blazing 45W speed via the built-in USB-C cable or Type-C port. Supports PD, PPS & QC 2.0 protocols for universal fast charging across devices.

Built-in USB-C Cable & Dual Type-C Ports — No extra cables needed. The integrated bidirectional USB-C lanyard cable supports both input and output, plus a second Type-C port for simultaneous dual-device charging — perfect for travel and daily commute.

Strong Magnetic Attachment — Securely snaps to your device or magnetic-compatible case with up to 13N of magnetic force. Effortless one-hand alignment — just snap and charge, no fumbling in the dark or on the go.
